title: sentilab-open-geometry/1
description: The preimage of geometry_sha256 (DESIGN rev 3 section 5.2): sha256(JCS({schema, problem, fixture_config_sha256, units, anchor, dies})). problem and fixture_config_sha256 come from the manifest (problem, fixture.config_sha256); units, anchor and dies from the proposal or check request, each die reduced to die, x_um, y_um and rot_deg. It excludes actor, time, key, salt, terms and client.
